name: qlrisk_price_bond_future
title: Price a BondFuture
description: Price one qlrisk BondFuture (Bond Future; futures, interest_rate): NPV in the trade currency and the reporting currency, pricing components, analytic Greeks where the pricer gives them, and optional cash flows. Inputs are this product's fields only; required: notional (maturity_date or tenor_years); pricer terms: bond_coupon, bond_maturity_years, conversion_factor, is_long, strike. Market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today; override curves, spots and vols, or apply shocks, with market_data as in qlrisk_price_trades. For a book of several products use qlrisk_price_trades. Example: {"notional": 1000000, "tenor_years": 5}.
